mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'tb_audit_log'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_audit_log (created_at, actor_id, actor_name, action, board_id, board_name, target_type, target_id, target_name, detail, client_ip) VALUES (#{createdAt}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{action}, #{boardId}, #{boardName}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{detail}, #{clientIp})

where.if: AND (a.target_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR a.board_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR a.detail ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR a.actor_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.created_at, a.actor_id, a.actor_name, a.action, a.board_id, a.board_name, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.target_name, a.detail, a.client_ip FROM tb_audit_log a
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
